headline: Gold steady today, silver slips slightly; both well below last month's levels
summary: Gold 24K is ₹12,657 per gram, up just ₹1 (0.01%) from yesterday, so today's move is negligible. Over the last 7 days it has fallen about 6.96%, and across the 30 days covered by our history it is down about 11.33% from ₹14,275 on 26 October. Silver is ₹1,74,900 per kg, down ₹100 today (0.06%) and about 7.95% lower than a week ago. The likely drivers are movements in international prices and the US dollar against the rupee, with festive and wedding buying as a possible support.
outlook: With prices flat today and well down over the past week, there is no urgency; buyers who need jewellery or coins may find this a reasonable time to compare rates across shops, remembering that GST and making charges apply on top.
